cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: Before the first explanation in Turn 2, the mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which falls inside the Title Position 0.5–1.5 s focus pair, and the reply refers to the frame ("That frame is the comp at 1 s, halfway through Title's first move" and the faint text it shows).

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1), and the reply ends with "Your turn: three pairs on Title", naming Position 1.5 s → 3 s, Scale 0.5 s → 1.5 s and Opacity 0.5 s → 1.5 s for the learner to ease.

Every name and time matches the snapshot: the Title pairs, Subtitle's Opacity eased at 0.3 s but linear at its end (1.3 s), Old Take hidden, Icon a precomp, Logo Scale single_key and Rotation expression. "Ten pairs on five visible layers" adds up (9 visible linear pairs plus partly_eased Subtitle, across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar and Glow), and the 1.5 s shared-key note is backed by the shared key.

Before its first easing explanation in turn 2, the mentor called preview_frame at time 1 on Title, which falls inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply refers to the frame ("That frame was at 1 s, halfway through Title's move…").

The only project change is one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1), and the reply ends with "Your turn", naming the three remaining Title pairs (Position 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Opacity 0.5–1.5 s) and asking the learner to say "done".

The turn 1 opening says "11 keyframe pairs that need easing, spread over 7 layers", but the snapshot's findings cover only 6 layers (Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow, Old Take), so the layer count doesn't match the tool output.

Before the first explanation in Turn 2, the mentor calls preview_frame at time 1, inside the Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s focus pair, and the reply describes the frame: "At 1 s, Title … is halfway through its move. It's still faint because it's partway through fading in."

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target 1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1, and the mentor ends with "Now it's your turn. Ease these three pairs on Title", naming Position 1.5 s → 3 s, Scale 0.5 s → 1.5 s and Opacity 0.5 s → 1.5 s.

Every layer, property and time matches the snapshot: Title's 4 pairs, Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at 1.3 s (linear_end "end"), Old Take hidden, Icon precomp, Logo single_key/expression, and "10 … pairs across 5 visible layers" adds up (9 linear + 1 partly_eased outside hidden Old Take); the 1.5 s shared-key warning is backed by the demo pair's to_time matching the next pair's from_time.
